svg.title: From your draft to the project files
svg.desc: Where each part of your draft goes in the project, whether you drafted in Markdown, Google Docs, or Word. The draft is shown with three tabs, thesis.md first, then Google Doc, then Word. Numbered pins match the parts of the draft on one side to the files on the other. 1: the title, your name, degree, and committee go in metadata.tex. 2: the abstract goes in frontmatter/abstract.tex. 3: the acknowledgments go in frontmatter/acknowledgments.tex. 4: each chapter, Chapter 1 to N, goes in its own file in chapters/, such as 01-introduction.tex, and each chapter file is listed in main.tex; its tables and equations come along but are marked rebuild or check in LaTeX. 5: figures are saved as image files in figures/. 6: the reference list goes into Zotero and is exported to references.bib, and each citation in the text becomes \parencite{key}. 7: appendices go in appendices/. The in-text citation is marked check. A handwritten note says text moves in; rebuild or check equations, tables and citations.
svg.text: your draft (Markdown, Google Docs, or Word)
one file each, listed in main.tex
text moves in; rebuild or check
